part.text:
Implemented the fix in `src/db.c:346`: the no-touch check now inspects the actually executing command, so `TOUCH` invoked from scripts still updates key access time while other script operations remain in no-touch mode.

Validated with `unit/introspection-2` and `unit/scripting`; all tests pass.
